_meta.title: Greece property facts for Israeli buyers (machine-readable)
_meta.rules: Every number carries source + as_of. confidence: high = statute/official document; medium = major firm, reputable press quoting officials, or aggregator of official data; low = single commercial or secondary source. null = unknown / not verified.

excluded: ethnic Greeks and long-term residents (ministers, 8 Sep 2026)

vat_new_build.mechanism: developer elects suspension; buyer then pays 3.09% transfer tax instead of VAT
vat_new_build.planned_extension_status: DBP 2027 + art. 17 of bill in consultation (existing suspensions auto-extended one year). NOT YET LAW.
vat_new_build.covers: building permits from 2006 onward incl. antiparochi; all unsold units under the permit once the developer files

lawyer_fee.note: not legally required since 1 Jan 2014; a Greek mortgage bank requires a Greek-bar lawyer with PoA for non-Greek borrowers

agent_fee.note: commonly 2% + VAT; sometimes only the seller pays

engineer_legality_certificate.legal_basis: Law 4495/2017 art. 83, restated in art. 368 of Law 5306/2026

afm_tax_number.how: Tax Office for Foreign Residents (Athens) in person, myAADE live video, or a tax representative with apostilled PoA

typical_total_buyer_cost.assumptions: lawyer 1% + VAT, agent 2% + VAT, objective value not above price, notary page fees excluded

border_zone_permit_non_eu.applies_to: non-EU/EEA natural and legal persons (Israelis included)

islands: entire Dodecanese (Rhodes, Kos, Patmos, Symi and others)
Diapontia islands (Corfu main island not listed)
mainland: parts of Drama, Ioannina, Pella, Serres

border_zone_permit_non_eu.process: prior approval by a committee of the Decentralised Administration (defence ministry vote); deal void without it; takes months

sources.note: area list to be checked against the law text

enfia.payment: lump sum or 12 monthly instalments from end of March
enfia.main_tax_formula: m2 x base(zone) x age_coef x floor_coef (or 1.02 detached) x facade_coef [x 0.10 auxiliary spaces] [x 0.40 unfinished]

insurance_discount.conditions: residence insured against earthquake, fire and flood for at least 3 months of the prior year (pro rata), insured value at least EUR 1,000/m2 of building

enfia.small_settlement_main_residence: 50% cut 2026 / exemption 2027 only for main residences of Greek tax residents - not relevant to non-residents
enfia.examples_note: objective value in examples approximated as m2 x zone price; real zone price per address must be looked up (AADE)

tap_municipal_fee.base: m2 x zone price x age coefficient

rental_income_tax_greece_individuals.deduction: flat 5% of gross; lost if rent is not paid through a bank (from 2026)
rental_income_tax_greece_individuals.long_term_lease_exemption: 36-month income-tax exemption for residences up to 120 m2 (+20 m2 per child beyond two) let 3+ years after 3 vacant years or STR-only prior year; leases signed by 31.12.2026, bill extends to end-2027

sources.note: table prints 45% on portion over 35,000 - typo vs 36,000

short_term_rental.definition: furnished lease under 60 days; AMA registration number from AADE required on every listing

business_threshold.effect: 3+ STR properties = business activity (business income, 13% VAT); up to 2 = property income, outside VAT

climate_resilience_fee_eur_per_night.payer: guest; host collects and declares to AADE

areas: 1st Municipal District: Plaka, Monastiraki, Syntagma, Omonia, Kolonaki, Exarcheia, Ilisia, Neapoli, Koukaki
2nd: Mets, Neos Kosmos, Agios Artemios, Pagrati
3rd: Petralona, Thiseio, Gazi, Votanikos, Metaxourgeio, Rouf

registration_freeze.planned_2027: extension for 2027 (3 Athens districts + 1 Thessaloniki community) listed in DBP 2027; not yet enacted
registration_freeze.transfer_rule: in restricted areas the AMA is deleted on sale, gift or parental transfer and cannot be re-registered while the restriction lasts

capital_gains_tax_greece.planned_status: DBP 2027 + art. 13 of bill in consultation; not yet law
capital_gains_tax_greece.note: a sale treated as business activity may be taxed as business income

foreign_rent_15pct_track.base: gross rent minus allowed depreciation only
foreign_rent_15pct_track.short_report: possible if no other duty to file; reported in form 1301 fields 345/285/225

foreign_rent_regular_track.rate: marginal individual rates (+ surtax above threshold)
foreign_rent_regular_track.foreign_tax_credit: yes, per income basket, form 1324 (appendix D to 1301); final tax paid within 24 months after year end; excess carried 5 years, CPI-linked
foreign_rent_regular_track.not_creditable: municipal taxes, purchase/transfer taxes (so ENFIA and Greek transfer tax are not creditable)

israel_tax.israeli_exempt_and_10pct_tracks: apply only to residential rent in Israel, not to foreign property

capital_gain_foreign_property.linear_split: gain to end-2011 up to 20%, later gain up to 25% (older holdings: other rules)
capital_gain_foreign_property.land_appreciation_tax_law: does not apply to foreign property

sources.note: form 1399 for capital gains other than listed securities

treaty_israel_greece.article_6_immovable_income: English text: taxable ONLY in the state where the property is (Greece). Hebrew text reportedly reads 'may be taxed'. Final clause: English prevails on divergence.
treaty_israel_greece.practical_status: UNRESOLVED: Israeli practitioners read arts 6/13 as exclusive Greek taxation (no Israeli tax); ITA guide only says 'subject to tax treaties'; no ITA ruling found

open_questions: whether a Greek flat counts as 'another apartment' for Israeli purchase tax / single-apartment exemption
National Insurance (Bituach Leumi) on foreign rental income
inflation adjustment method for foreign-currency property

anywhere: commercial/industrial converted to residential (legally completed before filing, after 5.4.2024) or listed-building restoration

short_term_rental_ban.not_retroactive: properties acquired under the old regime / transition
